discussion_comments.comment_body: Please centralize dashboard URL generation so the resolved app base URL and client attribution apply consistently to all account links. This changes Open dashboard and privacy settings to follow the configured environment, but usage, credits, and organization links still use hardcoded production URLs. A single dashboard URL builder would avoid sending users to different environments from the same account view.

in [`728da6af`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/728da6afab) every link in this view [goes through the builder](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-9523759fe5e95a4c04a7240c757c15da7ba9f4ae6540c8ac15925e4f7bb660a3R164): seven builder calls behind six buttons (dashboard, usage, credits on the user or organization route, create account, create organization, privacy settings). that was six hardcoded `app.cline.bot` constants at the merge base and none now. an unresolved app URL leaves each link undefined and its button hidden instead of falling back to production, which also covers proxy and self-hosted backends, where every link but privacy settings used to open production. [`281db607`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/281db607f0) applies the same builder to the desktop onboarding, connectors and welcome links.

Please remove the app URL reload from `refreshAccount`. The account/backend and environment are fixed for the app's lifetime, so resolve this configuration once at startup. A transport connection can retry the initial lookup if it failed, but after a successful lookup we don't need to reload it on every account refresh or reconnect. This also supersedes the earlier concern about clearing a stale URL after a runtime backend switch; that isn't a supported flow.

removed in [`728da6af`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/728da6afab). [`refreshAccount`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-51d0e9d12c66cf07b9303f12d282288c397b2e396ae7f1c404a00cebf2b34c7bR127) only fetches the user now. the lookup has one call site, the transport subscription, and stops after the first answer, so a reconnect only retries a startup lookup that failed. covered by [`resolves the Cline app once and keeps it across refreshes and reconnects`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-1ef61ec53cf8eed4470071337a35d29174dcd03a49149bbff67e27a84ab78539R209) and [`retries the Cline app lookup on reconnect until the sidecar answers`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-1ef61ec53cf8eed4470071337a35d29174dcd03a49149bbff67e27a84ab78539R173).

Fixed in `71f05e61`.

The LM Studio key field now uses the provider-config API-key path instead of updating only the legacy secret. The store maps `lmstudio` to `lmStudioApiKey`, so a write or clear updates both StateManager and `providers.json`; the UI uses the redacted `apiKeyLength` mask and keeps the field explicitly optional.

A regression test starts with different keys in both stores, writes an empty key, and verifies that both are cleared and the effective config has no API key.

Verification passed:
- 41 focused provider-store/effective-config/catalog-handler tests
- `bun run check-types`
- `bun run lint`
- `git diff --check`
